tagline.en: Interactive 3D scene generation from a single image — build an explorable world and extend it where you look.
tagline.zh: 从单张图片进行交互式 3D 场景生成——构建可探索的世界，并在你注视的方向上扩展它。

en: WonderWorld, from authors at Stanford University and MIT, generates an interactive 3D scene from a single input image. It turns one picture into an explorable world you can move through, and lets you extend the scene in whatever direction you choose to look.

It works by reconstructing the visible content into 3D and then filling in newly revealed regions — inpainting, segmenting, and estimating depth and normals — before turning them into a 3D Gaussian representation you can render from new viewpoints. The emphasis is on interactivity: the world grows as you explore it rather than being fully generated up front.

In WorldFoundry, WonderWorld runs through the shared 3D/4D pipeline: you supply a source image and configuration, and it drives the scene-generation flow. Running it end to end requires the checkpoint and runtime assets, plus PyTorch3D-compatible extensions, to be set up locally.
zh: WonderWorld 出自斯坦福大学与麻省理工的研究者，用于从单张输入图片生成交互式 3D 场景。它把一张图片变成可以在其中穿行探索的世界，并允许你朝任意注视方向扩展场景。
它先把可见内容重建为 3D，再补全新暴露出的区域——做图像补全、分割，并估计深度与法向——随后转化为可从新视角渲染的 3D 高斯表示。它强调交互性：世界随你的探索而生长，而非一次性全部生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中，WonderWorld 通过共享的 3D/4D pipeline 运行：你提供一张源图片和配置，它便驱动场景生成流程。端到端运行需要在本地准备好 checkpoint、运行时资源以及与 PyTorch3D 兼容的扩展。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to turn a single image into an interactive, explorable 3D scene and grow that world outward as you navigate — for demos, prototyping, or immersive exploration.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把单张图片变成可交互、可探索的 3D 场景，并在导航过程中把这个世界不断向外扩展时使用它——适合演示、原型与沉浸式探索。

notFor.en: Not a precise metric reconstruction of a real capture, and it has meaningful setup requirements — checkpoint and runtime assets plus PyTorch3D-compatible extensions must be available locally.
notFor.zh: 它不是对真实采集的精确度量重建，且有一定的环境要求——需在本地准备好 checkpoint、运行时资源以及与 PyTorch3D 兼容的扩展。

en: Interactive 3D scene generation from a single image
Extend the world in the direction you explore
Uses inpainting, segmentation and depth/normal cues, rendered as 3D Gaussians
zh: 从单张图片进行交互式 3D 场景生成
沿你探索的方向扩展世界
结合图像补全、分割与深度/法向线索，以 3D 高斯渲染
通过 WorldFoundry 共享的 3D/4D pipeline 运行
